title: MCP and Outlines Models
summary: This module provides specialized model implementations for integrating with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for sampling and for running local language models via the Outlines library, enabling structured generation and flexible deployment.

nodes.label: Model Request Parameters
nodes.title: Model Request Parameters
nodes.description: Encapsulates the input messages, model settings, and request parameters required to initiate a model generation or sampling process.

nodes.label: MCP Sampling Model
nodes.title: MCPSamplingModel
nodes.description: Facilitates model interaction using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for sampling. It sends requests to an MCP server and processes the sampling results, acting as a client for MCP-driven model calls.

nodes.label: Outlines Integration Model
nodes.title: OutlinesModel
nodes.description: Provides an adapter for integrating and running various local and non-API based language models (e.g., Hugging Face, LlamaCpp, SGLang) through the Outlines library, enabling structured generation and flexible model deployment.

nodes.label: MCP Server
nodes.title: Model Context Protocol Server
nodes.description: An external server that receives requests from the MCP Sampling Model and performs model inference based on the Model Context Protocol.

nodes.label: Local LLM Frameworks (Outlines)
nodes.title: Local LLM Frameworks
nodes.description: Represents various local Large Language Model frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, LlamaCpp, MLXLM, SGLang, vLLM) that are integrated and managed by the Outlines library for inference.

nodes.label: Model Response
nodes.title: Model Response
nodes.description: Represents the output generated by the language model, which can be a single response or a stream of responses, including text and other content parts.

groups.label: Generative Models
groups.title: Generative Models
groups.description: Core model implementations for generating responses.

groups.label: Data Flow
groups.title: Data Flow
groups.description: Components handling the input and output data for models.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External Systems
groups.description: External services or frameworks that interact with the models.
